name: Veyra Kest
seed: Ledger director and hidden funder of the second flood convoy. Demands dependency in return for security; runs with Corvin and Bale.
design: Female sable, deep chocolate fur, ivory chin, ink-blue tailored long coat, one warm brass clasp, composed posture.
history: Reedbank depot worker who rose through crisis logistics. At thirty-eight she diverted reserves to fund a rescue convoy; later consolidation convinced her that only centralized control prevents chaos.
desire: To make the Burrow sign a permanent exclusive supply agreement and prove that her form of order is indispensable.
contradiction: Her generosity becomes a claim of ownership. She remembers every life she helped but discounts lives injured by her conditions.
relationships: Corvin negotiates; Bale controls stock; Sela knows the rescue truth; Kavar is an occasional commercial counterpart.
arc: Season one: her offer fails despite a genuine good deed. Later: she must choose between saving her ledger and releasing stock without a binding promise. An act of repair can cost her power without erasing accountability.
story_engine: A negotiation where her diagnosis is partly right; a crisis in her own depot that exposes how little her workers trust her.
writer_truth: She did not cause the flood, invent Nix’s grievance or command Brakka’s raid. Her culpability is her present coercion.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
